summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026 disclosing routine daily ASX notifications under its existing stock repurchase program, which authorizes up to $1 billion in aggregate purchases of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock. No new authorization, price, premium, or transaction terms were stated. Disclosures were provided as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 to satisfy ASX daily reporting rules; the program does not obligate the company to repurchase shares. Watch actual buyback pace and any acceleration as signals of management's valuation view.
